ns2:course.label: Seminar Brazilian Literature
ns2:course.description: Advanced study of literary movements, major writers, and intellectual and cultural ideas in Brazilian literature; subject matter varies each time the course is offered. May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours if topics vary. Prerequisite: PORT 410 or consent of instructor.
